thread:
customer-sam: Hey team, after our IdP did a scheduled key rotation last night, several users started seeing 403s when calling the Redwood API. Console says 'Entitlement: plan_not_allowed' even though our seat billing shows active subscription. Anyone seen this before?
jess-support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a failing request id or example header? Is the 403 coming from API responses or the console UI? :thinking:
customer-sam: API responses. Example error from a request: `{"error": "403", "reason": "plan_not_allowed", "code": "ENTITLEMENT_DENIED"}`. Request-id: req_0a9f2b3c. It started at ~01:15 UTC.
arun-eng: tagging in — any chance the SSO claim mapping changed? We recently added support for an `entitlements` claim in SAML/OIDC assertions. If the IdP rotated keys and the assertion shape changed we might be missing the entitlement attribute.
mike-billing: I checked the billing side: tenant 42 has an active "team-pro" SKU, seats OK. No changes on our end.
jess-support: @customer-sam can you share a redacted ID token/assertion that produced the 403 (or the claim dump)? If not, can you confirm the `sub`/`email` didn't change?
customer-sam: attaching a redacted claim dump: 
```
{
  "iss": "https://idp.example.com",
  "sub": "user|12345",
  "email": "sam@custco.com",
  "groups": ["engineering"],
  "scope": "openid profile",
  "roles": ["user"]
}
```
customer-sam: notice there is no `entitlements` claim. Before rotation IdP used to send `entitlements: [{"product":"redwood","plan":"team-pro"}]`.
arun-eng: that explains it. Our entitlement-gating code looks for either (a) subscription bound in our internal DB or (b) an explicit `entitlements` claim. For newly minted tokens we prefer the claim if present; if missing we fallback to tenant lookup, but there's a cache window (5m) where we may use stale tenant id derived from `sub`. If `sub` namespace changed (looks like they added a prefix), our tenant lookup can miss and return a default plan (none) causing 403.
sre-lead: can you confirm if the rotated token changed the `sub` format? customer-sam indicated `sub` was `user|12345` — what was prior?
customer-sam: previous sub was `12345` (no prefix). IdP started adding `user|` during rotation.
arun-eng: yup that's the root cause. Tenant resolution by `sub` failed -> entitlement service returned no plan -> API returned ENTITLEMENT_DENIED. Two remediation paths: (1) Ask IdP to restore previous `sub` format or (2) update our mapping to normalize `sub` values and force a plan-sync for affected tenants.
jess-support: which is faster for the customer?
mike-billing: For immediate relief we can run a plan-sync for tenant 42 (force refresh). That's low-risk. Also we should add a temporary normalization rule to map `user|12345` -> `12345` while IdP sorts rotation.
arun-eng: I'll run a one-off sync and push a short-lived normalization rule in the entitlement matcher. Command I will run: `./tools/entitlement-sync --tenant=42 --force-refresh` and a config patch: `normalize_sub_patterns: ["^user\|(.*)$ -> \1"]` (will roll back after IdP confirms).
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2147 — entitlement mismatch after IdP rotation. Assigned: arun-eng, severity: low, ETA mitigation: 15m.
arun-eng: done — forced sync completed at 2105010200. Logs: `sync_success tenant=42 refreshed_plan=team-pro`. I also applied normalization rule in staging and tested with sample token — local test passed.
customer-sam: Confirmed — requests now succeed. Thank you.
jess-support: marking as resolved for now. Next steps: we should add better heuristics in entitlement resolution (fallback on email or groups), log a clearer diagnostic message (currently it's just ENTITLEMENT_DENIED), and add a non-breaking migration to tolerate common `sub` formatting changes.
sre-lead: Agreed. Please open a small RFC/PR to (a) enhance logging to include tenant lookup key and fallback path (no PII), (b) add normalization patterns config with audit log, and (c) add test coverage for rotated `sub` patterns.
arun-eng: will file PR and link INC-2026-2147.
mike-billing: FYI I'll inform the CS rep to ask the IdP to avoid changing `sub` format in future rotations or to include `entitlements` claim.
jess-support: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
